Item 7. Management Discussion and Analysis

During the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023, Acme Corp experienced robust revenue expansion across all core markets. Total consolidated revenue was $500,000,000, representing an increase of 12% compared to fiscal year 2022. Operating expenses were $380,000,000, driven by research and development investments.
